Why Tanot Solutions Exists

Tanot Solutions was born out of a problem that kept repeating across the SEO industry. Brands were spending serious budgets on link building, yet the vast majority of those links were low-quality, irrelevant, or violating Google's guidelines. Agencies were optimizing for volume, not value.

We founded Tanot Solutions in 2020 with one idea: build links the way a responsible editorial team would. Manually vetted, niche-relevant, client-approved, and built to last. Today, 15+ specialists serve 150+ brands across 20+ countries using that same process from day one.

"We started Tanot Solutions because the industry needed an agency that would defend every link it built in public, not one that hid its methods behind dashboards and jargon."

Our Mission And Vision

Two commitments that govern every campaign, every link, and every client relationship.

OUR MISSION
To make white-hat link building the obvious choice for every serious brand.

We exist to deliver editorial backlinks that actually move rankings, grow traffic, and support real business goals. Full transparency and zero shortcuts on every campaign. Every link we build should be something we are proud to show to a client, a journalist, and Google alike.

Quality over volume
OUR VISION
To become the most trusted SEO growth partner for brands that value long-term authority.

We are building toward a future where Tanot Solutions is the first name brands think of when they need a link-building partner they can trust to act as a true extension of their own team, across search, AI visibility, and content authority.

Built for the long term
From Day One To Where We Are Today

Six years of building, learning, and growing. One editorial link at a time.

2020
Founded
Tanot Solutions launches as a white-hat link building agency in Jodhpur, Rajasthan

Founded with a single mandate: deliver high-authority editorial backlinks with full client transparency and zero shortcuts. First clients onboarded in SaaS and B2B. The client-approval workflow and publisher vetting process were built from day one.

Year 1 of operations
2022
Scaling Up
50+ brands served and white-label link building launched for agencies worldwide

Crossed 50+ active brand partnerships. Launched white-label services for digital agencies. Publisher network grew to 500+ vetted sites across 15+ countries. Client retention surpassed 80%.

50+ brands served
2026
Today
Clutch Top Link Building Agency 2026 serving 150+ brands across 20+ countries

Named Clutch Top Link Building Agency 2026. 15+ specialists. A publisher network of 1,000+ vetted sites. Full services covering editorial link building, niche edits, guest posts, technical SEO, and AI search visibility. 5,000+ editorial backlinks delivered.

150+ brands worldwide
The Values Behind Every Campaign

These are not slogans. They are the operating principles that govern every link we build, every report we send, and every decision we make as an agency.

Quality Over Volume

We would rather build 10 genuinely relevant, editorially placed links than 100 that look fine in a spreadsheet and do nothing for your rankings.

Full Transparency

You approve every site before outreach begins. Every delivered link comes with a live URL, DR, estimated traffic, and anchor text. No black boxes, ever.

White-Hat Always

No PBNs, link farms, or manipulative schemes. Every method we use is one we would publicly defend in front of any SEO professional or Google reviewer.

Outcomes, Not Optics

We measure success in rankings, organic traffic, and ROI. Not link counts or domain rating scores alone. Your growth is our report card.

Long-Term Partnership

We do not disappear after delivery. We work as an extension of your team, thinking about your SEO goals the way a trusted in-house strategist would.

Relevance First

Every placement is matched to your niche and audience. We never chase domain rating numbers on sites that have nothing to do with your industry.

Awards And Industry Recognition

Independent recognition based on verified client reviews and campaign outcomes, not self-nomination.
